features.description: Circular plate blank, nominal diameter 13.248 and thickness 1.375, origin at the circular center on the front face.
Right-hand open slot/profile with 3.00 throat, 1.50 upper half width, typical 45° flanks and provisionally read 135° corner angles. Inner rounded end and final corner geometry require confirmation.

Central contoured recess/opening associated with the 7.000 diameter and side-view taper/profile. This feature type is a schema placeholder: the actual shape may require a revolved cut, not a straight extruded cut. Exact profile is not resolved well enough to build.
Seven drilled through mounting holes at individually dimensioned coordinates. Provisional diameter .656. No uniform seven-hole circular pattern should be applied.
Seven front-face counterbores, diameter 1.000 and .64 deep, each coaxial with a mounting through hole.
Four .250-20 tapped through holes, centered square with coordinates x=±1.900, y=±1.900.
Two .625-11 tapped through pull holes, upper right and lower left. Dimensioned horizontal offsets ±1.53; provisional vertical offsets ±5.73.
Two .312-18 blind tapped holes, threaded .75 deep. Candidate upper location x=-1.625 and y=+5.000 is not adequately confirmed; second location is unresolved. Do not assume diametric placement.
Conditional central-profile blend corresponding to handwritten .50 R; radius and attachment require confirmation.
Outside edge chamfer .06 × 45° at the indicated side-view edge. All-around extent or application to both faces is not explicitly established.

warnings: Second-pass corrections: D018 is now provisionally 135° TYP, not a .13-radius fillet; the previous F009 fillet has been removed. D012's speculative profile-intersection assignment has been withdrawn. H004's previously asserted first position has been withdrawn because extension-line attachment is not secure. D034 is explicitly a conditional derived estimate, not a confirmed printed radius.

The same degraded scan does not justify a general increase in confidence. It is not suitable for unattended modeling or release to manufacture until unresolved dimensions and feature attachments are checked against a better original.

Latest visible revision entry is C, REVISED DET. #4. Circled A callout markers are revision flags, not datums. No identifiable GD&T feature-control frames or datum-reference system are shown.
Dimensions in inches and third-angle projection are explicitly stated. No explicit ASME/ANSI/ISO/DIN designation is legible, so drawing_standard remains empty.

Mounting-hole and pull-hole coordinates in H001 and H003 are based on best readings of dimensioned locations. Some readings remain uncertain. The callout schema cannot carry per-coordinate uncertainty; consult the associated dimensions before using those coordinates.

instance_positions are referenced to the lower-left corner of the full nominal circular envelope. Conversion from center coordinates adds 13.248/2 = 6.624 to both x and y. This is not a separately dimensioned physical datum corner.

Cross-check of mounting coordinates: sqrt(4.198² + 4.198²) ≈ 5.9369 and sqrt(3.407² + 4.863²) ≈ 5.9372, consistent with 11.875/2 = 5.9375. Agreement supports, but does not prove, degraded digit readings. Seven equally spaced holes would be incorrect.
The four-hole square diagonal is 3.800 × sqrt(2) ≈ 5.3740, supporting the re-examined 5.375 B.C. REF reading. The reference value is non-controlling.
5.000 ±.005 and 6.000 ±.005 remain explicitly extracted but feature-unassigned. They must not be silently discarded or substituted for 4.863 and 5.937 mounting-hole ordinates.

The .312-18 blind-hole pair is not fully located. A possible first location is (-1.625,+5.000), but neither that attachment nor the second location is sufficiently secure. instance_positions is intentionally empty rather than inventing coordinates.

Central profile remains unresolved: exact attachments of .250, .83, 30°, 10°, .50 R and the front radius leader need verification. The intermediate concentric front arc has no separately readable diameter. No dimension has been inferred by scaling pixels.
D018's best reading is now 135° TYP, but a better scan must verify it and its attachment. Do not treat the earlier .13R interpretation as an additional independent callout.
The repeated central diameter annotations 7.000 and 7.00 agree nominally but invoke different general tolerances. Neither is marked REF; controlling annotation needs confirmation.
The mounting drill diameter and the small OD unilateral tolerance require verification. Counterbore diameter 1.000 and depth .64 are separately legible.
Angular dimensions and angular tolerances are degrees. unit='inch' in angular records is only a workaround for the schema, which lacks a degree unit.

No thread series/class, tap-drill size, blind drill-point depth, surface finish or unmarked chamfer extent has been invented. RC 28–32 is a heat-treatment hardness range, not a surface-finish callout.

General tolerances follow printed decimal precision where established. They do not establish thread fit. Derived values have no independent manufacturing tolerance; chains containing derived members check arithmetic but do not independently validate degraded source readings.
